facts.fact: The Cyber Security Authority operates CERT-GH, which the Communications Minister said responded to incidents in the first half of 2026.
CERT-GH of the Cyber Security Authority responded to 3,363 cybersecurity incidents between January and June 2026, per the Communications Minister.
The Communications Minister disclosed that CERT-GH handled 3,363 incidents for January to June 2026.
The Minister said vulnerability assessments were completed for 25 Critical Information Infrastructure institutions in education, health, public administration, security and utilities.
